title: Kapampangan language - Wikipedia
text: Kapampangan, Capampáñgan, or Pampangan, is an Austronesian language, and one of the eight major languages of the Philippines. It is the primary and predominant language of the entire province of Pampanga and southern Tarlac, on the southern part of Luzon 's central plains geographic region, where the Kapampangan ethnic group resides.
